title: Protected readonly odt 001
notes: ODF has no first-class readonly flag — settings.xml heuristic, honest stub. Real ODF document protection lives in settings.xml (office:document-settings, config:config-item-set), and even there Writer-level items are feature toggles (ProtectBookmarks/ProtectSections/...), not a document-wide read-only bit; a real password hash (config:document-passwordprotected-style) is not emitted here. This fixture adds a well-formed settings.xml part (media type text/xml, manifest entry) with an OpenOffice.org/Writer config-item-set carrying ProtectSections boolean false: a protection-flavored marker a renderer may legitimately ignore. Reference text covers only the two body paragraphs; no normative ODF counter matches settings/config elements, so feature counts stay 0.
